### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

### Load annotation file

- Load ensembl annotation gtf.

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

annotation_gtf <- "/nemo/lab/patanir/home/users/palk/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```


- Add gene names 

```{r}

all_de_genes_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(all_de_genes_df$gene_ids, annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]



```

- Add entrez ids

```{r}

library("AnnotationDbi")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
all_de_genes_df$entrez_id = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys=all_de_genes_df$gene_ids,
                    column="ENTREZID",
                    keytype="ENSEMBL",
                    multiVals="first")

sig_de_genes_df <- all_de_genes_df[all_de_genes_df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(all_de_genes_df$padj),]

```

- Make Volcano plots

```{r}

require("ggrepel")
source("src/plot_functions.R")

lapply(unique(sig_de_genes_df$contrast), function(x){
    current_sig_df <- sig_de_genes_df[sig_de_genes_df$contrasts == x & !is.na(sig_de_genes_df$gene_name) & !(sig_de_genes_df$gene_name %in% c("CES1", "ISCA2", "ELFN2")),]
    current_plot_df <- all_de_genes_df[all_de_genes_df$contrasts == x & !is.na(all_de_genes_df$gene_name) & !(all_de_genes_df$gene_name %in% c("CES1", "ISCA2", "ELFN2")),]
    highlight_genes <- current_sig_df$gene_name[!(current_sig_df$gene_name %in% current_plot_df$gene_name[duplicated(current_plot_df$gene_name)])]
    label_genes_df <- current_plot_df[current_plot_df$gene_name %in% highlight_genes,]
    label_genes <- label_genes_df$gene_name[order(label_genes_df$padj, decreasing = F)][1:10]


    make_volcano_plot(plot_df = current_plot_df, 
        logfc_threshold = 2, 
        logfc_col = "logfc", 
        gradient_pal = "RdBu", 
        pval_col = "padj",
        highlight_genes = highlight_genes,
        label_genes = label_genes,
        plot_pvalue_threshold = 0.05,
        filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste(paste(output_prefix(), x, sep = "_"), ".pdf", sep = "")), plot_width = 7, plot_height = 7)
})

```
